note: Published DocVQA results for comparison with dataset_and_metrics.json. Checked against the primary sources on 2026-09-16. Published numbers use the full split and a model answering directly from the image; this project scores 25 validation questions after the answer passes through retrieval and FLAN-T5, so the comparison is indicative, not like-for-like.
